audit.whatIsWrong: Garen wins 58.71% over 4393 games — his best matchup in this slice — yet diff reads EVEN at 5.5/10 and the chart hands Level 6 and First item to 'Skill' while the packet chart gives Garen all six pre-late stages.
audit.why: The prose on those two rows already says Garen wins them ('Your level 6 R execute answers his pre-item R with ease', 'you burst him before his tank build spikes'). Only the side tokens disagree.
audit.corrected: Flipped win[4], win[5] and phases[4..5].side/rating as one group, set diff FAV / 4-10 difficulty, and updated the two window summaries.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5].t gives All Out a 90s cooldown.
audit.why: All Out is 120/100/80s — 120 at rank 1, longer than the page claims, and it also heals him, which is what makes the Grievous Wounds timing matter.
audit.corrected: Rewrote report[5].t with the real number and the heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup never states what Ntofo Strikes actually does at two stacks, never mentions that Path Maker deals true damage while reducing the damage he takes during the charge, and never mentions Footwork's shield or the wall knock on All Out.
audit.why: These are the four interactions that decide every trade. Ntofo Strikes is 3.5s flat and the second stack fires the pull — the silence lands there, not on the first. Path Maker's true damage means armour does not save you and the charge window is damage-reduced, so burst into it is wasted. Footwork shields on the dash. All Out launches you through a wall, and Garen has no dash to get back.
audit.corrected: Wrote them into spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, wants.you[1], dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.why: Executioner's Calling first back and Mortal Reminder third is right here — All Out genuinely heals him, so the needs-antiheal flag is already served.
